ops.text: The consent requirement in the preceding sentence does not apply to an assignment by Sparkling to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets; Sparkling's consent to an assignment by Garman shall not be unreasonably withheld; Garman may not assign this Agreement to a competitor of Sparkling; and a change of control of Sparkling does not give Garman any right to terminate this Agreement.

ops.oldText: (c) not assign this Agreement or transfer, lease, export or grant a sublicence of the Work to any Person, except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;
ops.newText: (c) not assign this Agreement or transfer, lease, export or grant a sublicence of the Work to any Person, except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing or as permitted by this Agreement;

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We left paragraph (d) intact and added one short sentence carving out our assignments to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, applying a reasonableness standard to consent, barring Garman from assigning to a competitor, and confirming a change of control of Sparkling gives Garman no termination right. Section 3(c) is conformed by a short cross-reference so it does not re-impose the bar; a mutual successor-assignment right on written notice is our fallback.
proposal.summary: Insert a short carve-out after paragraph (d) permitting Sparkling's affiliate/successor assignments, a reasonableness standard on consent, a competitor bar on Garman, and no Vendor termination right on our change of control.

mappings.quote: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
